name: CFA Level I - Corporate Finance
description: The CFA Level I Corporate Finance topic (renamed from Corporate Issuers in 2027) in full: all 7 modules covering organisational forms and ownership, investors and stakeholders including ESG, corporate governance, working capital and liquidity, capital investments and capital allocation (NPV, IRR, ROIC), capital structure and WACC with the Modigliani-Miller propositions, and business models. Eighth topic in the study order.
author: eclipse
